amdahl_sensitivity.formula: S_total = 1 / (1 - p + p / r + h); p is affected baseline critical-path fraction, r local speedup, h added overhead / baseline total time.
amdahl_sensitivity.why_fraction_is_not_identified: Training counts have no time fields; saved earlier CPU-graph aggregates do not isolate final IQ2_S/IQ3_S compact dots; perf-control files record capture controls, and call counters do not time calls. Whole-model ABBA records overall predicted time only.
amdahl_sensitivity.overhead_budget_formula: h <= p * (1 - 1/r) - g/(1+g) for target total gain g. At g=0 use a strict inequality for any positive gain. Negative budgets mean the target is impossible even with zero added overhead.
